newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso edges up in speculative session.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso edges up in speculative session.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 90 centavos to close at 1,073.1 against the dollar in markets driven by speculation, interbank traders said.
"Financial institutions were speculating there would be demand for greenbacks after the U.S. President Day's holiday Monday. But in fact that demand failed to materialize," one dealer said.

Another dealer said exporters and importers were waiting to see the effects of a possible fall in domestic interest rates and the outcome of the U.S. decision on whether to certify Colombia as an ally in the drug war.
Dealers reported 299 operations worth a total $118 million. The peso hit an intraday high of 1,072.5 against the dollar and a low of 1,075.7.
